prompts.title: Medical Composure
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4K ultra-detailed cinematic black-and-white low-key studio portrait of a professional nurse (male or female). The subject conveys calm authority, discipline, and quiet confidence. Lips are gently closed—relaxed yet firm—and the eyes maintain steady, direct contact with the viewer.
Face & Hair Accuracy

Maintain strong resemblance to the provided reference image, preserving accurate facial structure, proportions, and natural features. The hairstyle should closely reflect the reference in texture, length, volume, density, and styling direction, remaining natural and realistic.
Clothing & Details

The subject wears dark medical scrubs with a clean, structured V-neck design and tailored fit. The fabric appears matte with minimal wrinkles. A stethoscope rests naturally around the neck in a slightly asymmetrical position. The tubing has a smooth matte finish, while the metallic chest piece catches subtle studio highlights.
Pose

The subject stands with arms crossed across the torso in a grounded, confident stance. Forearms rest horizontally with hands tucked beneath the upper arms. Shoulders are squared, posture upright, and chin slightly elevated, conveying professionalism and composure.
Composition

Waist-up portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. The composition is centered and balanced. The head sits slightly above the middle of the frame. Crossed arms create a strong horizontal base, and the face remains the primary focal point. Background is a seamless dark grey studio gradient.
Lighting (Black & White Studio)

Soft key light from the front-left, slightly above eye level, creates gentle highlights on one side of the face with smooth shadow transitions on the opposite side. Medium contrast with refined tonal balance, controlled blacks, preserved highlights, and a subtle vignette for depth.
Technical Look

Portrait lens aesthetic (similar to 85mm), sharp focus on the eyes, detailed skin texture, visible hair strands, realistic fabric detail, clean tonal range, and ultra-high-resolution 4K output suitable for editorial publication.

prompts.title: Medical Authority
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4K ultra-realistic HDR portrait (aspect ratio 4:5) of the same man from the uploaded reference image, using accurate face matching and strict identity preservation. The facial features must remain identical, including face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eye color, grooming details, and neutral-serious expression. The image should look like the same person photographed in a hospital environment, not a modified or stylized version.
The man stands front-facing in a hospital corridor with arms crossed, maintaining natural body proportions, confident posture, and realistic hand placement.
Outfit: white doctor’s coat with realistic folds, light-blue scrubs underneath, blue lanyard with ID card, and a stethoscope around the neck with natural positioning and metallic reflections.
Setting: bright modern hospital hallway with large windows on the left, soft blue walls, white ceiling panels, blurred medical staff in the background, and a medical cart on the right. Use cinematic depth of field to keep the subject sharp and the background softly blurred.
Lighting: soft natural daylight mixed with cool hospital lighting, producing smooth shadows, realistic skin texture, and a cool blue-white color palette.
Quality: 4K hyper-realistic, sharp focus, accurate perspective, HDR depth, and lifelike textures.
